clues.it: Dario era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a una cassa e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Dario was in the 5th column, beside a crate and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un salvagente, a ovest di Olga e da solo sul Ponte.
clues.en: Luca was beside a life ring, west of Olga and alone on the Deck.

clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª riga e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd row and in the Galley, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 3ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 3rd column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Olga era nella 12ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Irene.
clues.en: Olga was in the 12th column, in the 5th row and in the same room as Irene.

clues.it: Irene era nella 8ª colonna e in Cabina.
clues.en: Irene was in the 8th column and in the Cabin.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 2ª colonna, su una corda ed esattamente una riga a nord di Paolo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd column, on a rope coil and exactly one row north of Paolo.

clues.it: Paolo era a ovest di Marta e in Cabina.
clues.en: Paolo was west of Marta and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Giada era su una corda e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Giada was on a rope coil and west of Marta.

clues.it: Marta era nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Marta was in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Nino era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a una rete, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Nino was in the 7th column and beside a net, but was not beside a chair.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 11ª.
steps.en: Luca's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 2nd, column 11th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 4th.

steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 12th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 6ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 6th, column 8th.

steps.it: Solo Rosa può stare nella 7ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Rosa is the only one who can be in the 7th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 2nd.
